handoff.purpose: Implements spectral clustering heuristic: computes eigenvalues, picks cluster count via eigengap, handles disconnected graphs, and defines analyse function signature.

claims.text: The multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 IS the number of connected components -- exactly, as a theorem.
claims.why: The code uses nx.number_connected_components(graph) and then sets k = components explicitly, relying on this theorem.

claims.text: So on a disconnected graph the first `components` eigenvalues are all 0 and every gap between them is float noise; picking the largest of them returned a k derived from rounding error.
claims.why: The code bypasses _pick for disconnected graphs and uses components instead, confirming that _pick would be unreliable.

claims.text: The honest answer is the component count, and the interesting one is the giant component's, reported separately.
claims.why: Code sets k = components and later computes scope_k from giant component via _giant (unseen) and _pick.

claims.text: a winning gap barely ahead of the next one is a coin flip wearing a number's clothes. Say so instead of reporting k as a fact.
claims.why: Code includes 'confident' boolean based on gap > 1.5*runner and gap > 0.02, and 'basis' string describes if confident or not.

claims.text: Supply exactly one graph source: ``graph`` (already built), ``report`` (a :class:`~daedalus.mapping.reach.ReachReport`), or ``repo_root`` (in which case ``reach.analyse`` is called -- a WHOLE-REPO PASS, MEASURED at ~11s on this tree, which is why no hot path calls this without being asked to).
claims.why: The docstring claims that reach.analyse is called when repo_root is supplied; this chunk does not contain the body of analyse to verify that call. Also the timing claim cannot be verified from code.

claims.text: ``scope_prefixes`` is echoed into the result as ``scope`` so a reading can never be quoted without saying what it was taken over.
claims.why: This chunk does not show the return dictionary including 'scope' key; it appears in the next chunk.

claims.text: See :func:`graph_from_reach` for why you probably want ``("daedalus/",)``.

observations.what: Function _spectrum uses nx.normalized_laplacian_spectrum but does not handle the case where the graph has no nodes; may return empty list.
Function _pick returns (1, 0.0, 0.0) when gaps list is empty (i.e., top<1). This is a fallback but may not be meaningful.
In the disconnected case, scope_k, scope_gap, scope_confident are computed from giant component but only if giant has >=3 nodes and >0 edges; otherwise they remain None. This is handled in output.
The output dictionary keys 'clusters', 'gap', 'runner_up_gap', 'confident', 'basis' are populated; 'gap' and 'runner_up_gap' are rounded to 6 decimals.
The 'declared_packages' and 'reads_as' keys are added only if declared_blocks is not None.
The analyse function signature uses Any for types and does not validate inputs; it returns a dict with 'available': False on various failures.
